successCriteria.description: When PgLeaveBalanceRepository.update is called with a non-empty changes object and an id that matches no row, it throws NotFoundError (statusCode 404, code NOT_FOUND) with message 'Leave balance not found' instead of throwing a TypeError.
When the UPDATE affects at least one row, update still returns the mapped LeaveBalance for the updated row (existing happy-path behavior is preserved).
The zero-row check uses the pg QueryResult.rowCount signal (rows affected by the UPDATE), not result.rows.length, to decide the missing-row case.

constraints: No signature change to IBalanceRepository.update — it keeps returning Promise<LeaveBalance> and accepting the optional trailing PoolClient.
No new import is required — NotFoundError is already imported in balance.repository.ts from '../../shared/errors'.
The empty-changes branch (fields.length === 0) must keep its existing behavior: findById then throw NotFoundError('Leave balance not found') when missing, else return the existing row.
outOfScope: No changes to the empty-changes branch, the dynamic SET-clause construction, FIELD_COLUMNS mapping, or any other repository method (create/findById/findByKey).
No changes to the IBalanceRepository interface signature, the BalanceService, routes/controllers, or any transaction/audit behavior.

ambiguities.description: Verification strategy: is a new automated test required to prove the fixed behavior, or is the change acceptable without one?
options: Require a new automated test that exercises the real repository's update against a zero-affected-row result
Accept the change without a new test, relying on existing coverage and manual verification

entityInvariants.invariant: An update against a non-existent LeaveBalance id must surface as NotFoundError(404), never as an untyped runtime error (TypeError) or a silently-returned undefined.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws NotFoundError(404, code NOT_FOUND, message 'Leave balance not found') when the target row does not exist; returns the updated LeaveBalance otherwise.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The missing-row error must match the existing NotFoundError contract (statusCode 404, code NOT_FOUND) and the message 'Leave balance not found' already used by the empty-changes branch of the same method.
The fix must align with the architecture's stated contract that update throws NotFoundError(404) when the row is missing.

integrationPoints.why: The fix must throw the existing NotFoundError type to preserve the cross-cutting error contract.
